page.title: Device
page.purpose: Show one device's probed capability matrix, its host node and transport, its strategy options, and its session history.

priorities.statement: The capability matrix distinguishes available, unavailable, and unsupported without collapsing them.
priorities.notes: Unsupported is terminal; unavailable is fixable. Merging them hides the actionable case.

priorities.statement: Which strategy would be selected, and why, is visible before any run starts.
priorities.notes: Strategy selection determines which resolution rungs are reachable, so it must not be implicit.

priorities.statement: Host node and transport are shown, because reachability depends on them.
priorities.notes: An attached device is only as reachable as the node it hangs off.

states.description: Device record and latest snapshot loading.
Host node online; capability matrix reflects a current probe.
Host node offline; the exact reason is displayed and no verb controls are offered.
A capability probe is in flight; prior snapshot shown as stale.
A lease is held on this device; holder and expiry are visible.
